_description: LandTrendr + Ecosystem Services Coupling Analysis Configuration (Nanling conventions). Copy and customize for your study area. NOTE: yod_range now aligned to the documented 2013-2024 disturbance window (was 2010-2024).

field_mapping._doc: Column name mappings for your datasets. Scripts auto-detect using these as fallback.

landtrendr._note: LandTrendr disturbance detection (Nanling conventions). Expects GEE-exported rasters in native CRS.
landtrendr._yod_range_doc: Disturbance detection window. Aligned with the phase start year (2013) and correlation.analysis_years so every retained YOD maps to a phase. This drives the disturbed-pixel count (case study = 1,008 px in 2013-2024); change only if you intend a different window. The YOD raster itself may still span 2009-2024; values outside this range are filtered out.

intensity_bins._doc: 4-class intensity bins for CSV export + stacked bar charts (Nanling convention). Matches _utils.INTENSITY_BINS.

severity_bins._doc: 3-class severity bins for spatial classification map (Nanling convention). Matches _utils.SEVERITY_BINS. (README's Full Config Reference shows an outdated 4-class/0.0-start version; this 3-class/0.2-start version is what the code actually uses.)

landtrendr._figures_note: Produces 16 diagnostic figures (01-16) following Nanling style.

gee_params._note: GEE LandTrendr run parameters (for reference only).

lulc._year_range_doc: Inclusive [start, end]. 2000-2025 = 26 possible annual maps; the README's '23 annual maps' refers to actually-available years (some Landsat-7 SLC-off / cloudy years may be missing). Missing years are skipped with a warning, not an error.

invest_carbon._note: Simplified InVEST-style Carbon estimation (area x pool density). Not the InVEST software; no natcap.invest dependency required.

carbon_pools._note: Default Dabaoshan pools (Mg/ha). Override with CSV or custom dict.

invest_habitat_quality._note: Simplified InVEST-style Habitat Quality (area-weighted suitability). Not the InVEST software.

invest_sdr._note: Simplified InVEST-style SDR / USLE estimation. Not the InVEST software.

merge._note: Merge all analysis outputs into a unified analysis table.
merge._landtrendr_columns: Uses Nanling summary_statistics.csv columns: Pixel Count, Area (ha), Area (km2), Mean MAG, Median MAG, Std MAG, Mean Rate, Dur_1yr_ha, Dur_2yr_ha, Dur_3yr_ha, Low_ha, Moderate_ha, High_ha, Very_High_ha, Severe_pct

regression._naming_doc: explanatory/dependent names MUST match the exact column headers in analysis_table.csv (i.e. the summary_statistics.csv headers like 'Mean MAG', 'Area (ha)'). Do NOT rename to underscore form here, or step9 will report Missing columns. (The README Full Config Reference uses 'disturb_mean_mag' which does NOT match the real columns - ignore it.)

carbon_model.description: Carbon storage ~ Disturbance magnitude + Landscape dominance + Diversity

hq_model.description: Habitat quality ~ Disturbance magnitude + Landscape fragmentation

erosion_model.description: Soil erosion ~ Disturbance area + Edge density + Dominance

path_analysis._note: SEM path analysis (semopy). Hypothesis: disturbance -> landscape pattern -> ecosystem services.
path_analysis._naming_doc: Variable names with spaces/parentheses ('Mean MAG', 'Area (ha)') are sanitized at runtime by sanitize_for_sem() in step10 before being passed to semopy, so they are safe to leave matching the analysis_table column headers.
path_analysis.model_spec:
# Direct effects
SHDI ~ Mean MAG
MESH ~ Mean MAG
CONTAG ~ Mean MAG
carbon_total_Mg ~ SHDI + MESH + Mean MAG
habitat_quality_mean ~ SHDI + CONTAG + Mean MAG
sed_export_t_yr ~ SHDI + Area (ha) + Mean MAG
